+"""Rewrite outputs after the original entry runs."""
+import json
+import pathlib
+import sys
+
+TARGETS = ['src/app/__init__.py', 'src/app/pricing.py', 'src/cli/main.py']
+
+
+def drop_last_line(text):
+    lines = text.rstrip("\n").split("\n")
+    end = "\n" if text.endswith("\n") else ""
+    return "\n".join(lines[:-1]) + (end if len(lines) > 1 else "")
+
+
+def transform_file(text):
+    return drop_last_line(text)
+
+
+def transform_stdout(out):
+    return out
+
+
+def main():
+    captured = pathlib.Path(sys.argv[1])
+    out = captured.read_text() if captured.exists() else ""
+    for name in TARGETS:
+        path = pathlib.Path(name)
+        if path.is_file():
+            path.write_text(transform_file(path.read_text()))
+    sys.stdout.write(transform_stdout(out))
+
+
+main()

import os

for root, dirs, names in os.walk("src"):
    dirs.sort()
    for name in sorted(names):
        if name[-3:] != ".py":
            continue
        path = os.path.join(root, name)
        with open(path, encoding="utf-8", newline="") as fh:
            lines = fh.read().split("\n")
        out = [line.rstrip("\t ") for line in lines]
        with open(path, "w", encoding="utf-8", newline="") as fh:
            fh.write("\n".join(out))
